hooks: Day 1 starts at Nuldam Space, where you write a letter to your future self that they mail later
Tip: ride the Namsan Cable Car about two hours before sunset (Day 4)
Found Starfield Library pretty but not essential (Day 5)

list.title: Seoul in 4-5 days: Bon Traveler's 15 stops
list.desc: Places from Bon Traveler's 'The Ultimate 4-5 Days Seoul Itinerary' (https://www.bontraveler.com/seoul-itinerary/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Bon Traveler.

items.title: Nuldam Space, Gyeongbokgung (늘담 경복궁점)
items.memo: Cafe where you write a letter to your future self; they mail it later.

items.title: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌한옥마을)
items.memo: Hanok lanes open to visitors 10am-5pm; see Photo Spot #6.

items.title: Samcheongdong Sujebi (삼청동수제비)
items.memo: Michelin-listed hand-pulled dough soup and potato pancakes.

items.title: Oncheonjip (온천집)
items.memo: Shabu-shabu in an Ikseon-dong courtyard; reserve ahead.

items.title: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
items.memo: Night food tour: about 2.5 hours and a dozen tastings.

items.title: Changdeokgung Palace (창덕궁)
items.memo: UNESCO palace from 1405; Secret Garden needs its own ticket.

items.title: Myeongdong Kyoja (명동교자 본점)
items.memo: Michelin-listed hand-cut noodle soup and dumplings.

items.title: Coffee Hanyakbang (커피한약방)
items.memo: Retro coffee shop tucked in an alley.

items.title: Namdaemun Market (남대문시장)
items.memo: Big, less touristy market; look for hotteok and wang mandu.

items.title: N Seoul Tower (N서울타워)
items.memo: Take the cable car up about two hours before sunset.

items.title: Starfield Library (별마당 도서관)
items.memo: Towering book walls in COEX; pretty but not essential, she says.

items.title: Seoul Forest Park (서울숲)
items.memo: Park walk to round off the Seongsu day.

message.subject: I listed your Seoul itinerary on one map
message.body:
Hi Jessica, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

Starting Day 1 by writing a letter to your future self at Nuldam Space is such a nice touch. I put 15 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/bontraveler-seoul-4-5-days

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
